hero.heading: A small team, deliberately.
hero.lead: Cruxy was founded in 2018 by engineers who were tired of watching good brands lose revenue to bad infrastructure. We stay small so the people who sell the work are the people who ship it.

operate.heading: How we operate
operate.lead: Four principles that decide what we take on and how we run it.

principles.title: One metric, agreed up front
principles.desc: Before a line of code, we agree on the single number the engagement is judged by. Everything else is context.

principles.title: Senior people only
principles.desc: No account layer, no juniors learning on your store. The people in the kickoff are the people doing the work.

principles.title: Own your stack
principles.desc: We build on documented, standard Shopify and Klaviyo patterns. Nothing we ship requires us to stay.

principles.title: Speed is a feature
principles.desc: Performance budgets are set at the start and enforced through launch. Slow is a bug, not a tradeoff.

process.heading: Our process
process.lead: The same four phases on every engagement, scaled to the scope.

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.desc: Technical, lifecycle, and analytics audit. We find where revenue is leaking and price the fixes.

steps.title: Architect
steps.desc: A prioritized roadmap with scope, sequencing, and the expected impact of each workstream.

steps.title: Build
steps.desc: Two-week cycles with a shared board. You see progress on staging every sprint, not at the end.

steps.title: Compound
steps.desc: Post-launch testing, lifecycle iteration, and performance monitoring against the agreed metric.

team.heading: The team
team.lead: Eleven specialists across engineering, lifecycle, and analytics. Here are the leads you'll work with.

cta.heading: Let's see if we're a fit.
cta.body: We take on a limited number of engagements each quarter so the senior team stays on every project.
